LOCATED ONLY 6 MILES SOUTH OF DOWNTOWN ELLICOTTVILLE, HOLIDAY VALLEY GOLF & SKI RESORT, ADVENTURE PARK, AND HOLIMONT SKI RESORT.A POPULAR YEAR-ROUND DESTINATION FOR SKIING, GOLFING, MOUNTAIN BIKING, SNOWMOBILING, FISHING AND COMMUNITY EVENTS, THIS PROPERTY OFFERS BOTH RURAL LIVING AND EASY ACCESS TO LOCAL AMENITIES.
THIS PROPERTY PROVIDES A PERFECT COMBINATION OF RURAL LIFESTYLE, AGRICULTURAL POTENTIAL, AND INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITIES. WHETHER YOU’RE LOOKING FOR A SPACIOUS PROPERTY TO BUILD YOUR DREAM HOME, DEVELOP INTO A RESIDENTIAL COMMUNITY, OR EMBARK ON AGRICULTURAL OR FORESTRY PROJECTS, THIS LAND HAS IT ALL. DON'T MISS OUT ON THIS EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY.
